notes: 2.2 uH, 4.1 A rated, 5.6 A saturation, magnetic shielded, 6x6 mm, 27k stock, $0.068.
The 3.3 V rail peaks around 0.82 A (ESP32-C6 transmit plus W5500), so 5.6 A saturation is heavily oversized - roughly 7x margin.

OVERSIZED ON PURPOSE ONLY BY AVAILABILITY: it was the 2.2 uH part with real stock in the assembly catalogue. A 4x4 or 3x3 mm part would free board area and is worth revisiting at layout if space is tight. No electrical reason to prefer the larger one.
